meta.description: A CRM enrichment provider (Clearbit-style) often caps requests per lead per hour, and a batch of newly-captured leads can easily exceed that if sent as one burst. This workflow replaces a direct HTTP Request node with Jitterflow, targeted per leadId — each lead's enrichment call gets its own pacing lane, so concurrent leads don't fight over the same rate-limit window, and a failed enrichment call lands in the DLQ for one-click replay instead of silently dropping.
setup: Precede the Jitterflow node with whatever node produces your lead list (a CRM "new leads" trigger, a database query, etc.) — this template starts from an hourly poll as a placeholder.
Replace YOUR_JITTERFLOW_ENDPOINT_KEY with an endpoint whose destination URL points at your enrichment provider's API.
Each input item's leadId becomes the Target Identifier, so Jitterflow paces per lead rather than per endpoint.
